## Description

A line of mouse embryonic fibroblasts (3T3, Todaro and Green 1962–63), the line of contact
inhibition: spindle-shaped (~70 × 20 µm spread; volume ~1800 µm³ estimated) and stuck to the bottom,
they slow down when they touch and stop dividing when they fill the dish.

## In the simulation

<!-- GENERATED:presence -->
Drops: not seeded in the default drops (inoculate it from the Catalogue).
<!-- /GENERATED -->

An adherent [animal cell](../../mechanics/animal-cells.md) with contact inhibition of locomotion and
proliferation; migration 0.1–0.5 µm/min with a persistence of 2.5 h.

## Literature

- JCRB Cell Bank JCRB0615 (NIH/3T3 clone 5611): doubling ~19 h (others give 20–24 h).
- Gail M.H., Boone C.W. (1970) Biophys. J. 10: 980–993 (persistence 2.5 h, random at 5 h).
- Todaro G.J., Green H. (1963) Quantitative studies of the growth of mouse embryo cells in culture
  and their development into established lines. J. Cell Biol. 17: 299–313.
- arXiv:0806.4518 (3T3 speed on 2D substrates).
- Alberts B. et al. *Molecular Biology of the Cell*, 6th ed., fig. 17-4 (S 8 h, G2 4 h, M 1 h of a typical human cell).
- Carruthers A. (1990) Facilitated diffusion of glucose. Physiol. Rev. 70: 1135–1176 (GLUT1 Km ~1–3 mM).

## Not implemented yet

- Confluence and metabolism use human fibroblast values; not yet validated.
- No phase-contrast lens yet: cultures are seen in bright field (roadmap C).
- Not supported in the well-mixed culture.

## Unique and shared mechanics

Shares the [animal-cell machinery](../../mechanics/animal-cells.md) with the human fibroblast.
